chapter: Russell's band, records and Armstrong in the studio
title: The 'Tight Like That' vocalist from New Orleans
summary: Hearing the vocalist, he recalls working with him in an act at Chez Florence, a job that lasted two weeks.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: [TAPE III, SIDE 2 STARTS WITH "TIGHT LIKE THAT"]
Was he around New York then?

No, he come in... Well, I mean, he was trying to make it, but he didn't last too long. He didn't stay around too long. You know, he didn't get no breaks. I worked with him at the Chez Florence downtown, as part of a nightclub act. I think I was telling you about it.
He was one of the entertainers down there. He was working down there.
He was from New Orleans. He came in... Russell brought him in, and then he was working around, making records, one thing or another. Then he got this job
at the Chez Florence... You know, at that time I had left Russell's band again, and I was at the Chez Florence. Good job all my good jobs blow up. I think it lasted two weeks.
